caption: The drawing features three views of a single ring, each carefully rendered on a light tan background. The ring is gold in color with a round setting at the top, which contains a domed, light-colored stone or cameo surrounded by a border of small, round, white or pale blue gemstones. The top view of the ring is positioned at the upper center, showing the circular arrangement of the gemstones around the central piece. The side view on the lower right reveals the depth of the domed stone and the thick, tapering band that supports it. The profile view on the lower left displays the circular shape of the band and the prominent height of the centerpiece above the finger. The artist’s name, "John H. Tercuzzi," appears in small letters in the lower left corner of the drawing. The paper shows some signs of aging, such as faint stains and a slightly uneven tone.
title: Mourning Ring
